style: stylized 3D cartoon, original design, vivid saturated colors, high contrast
subject: ONE serious cat-sized hamster, warm ginger fur, white chest, upright on the checkout counter; huge stuffed cheeks; they deflate only after the coins pour out at 5.0; never smiles
second_characters: ONE cashier woman about 45 in a bright blue uniform, blank badge
props: ONE card terminal, screen shows only a red cross; ONE bread loaf in a paper bag
environment: clean bright checkout: white counter, glossy moving lane, yellow accents, simple background
lighting: bright warm key light on the hero, cyan and magenta rims, the hero stands out
motion_rule: camera always moving from frame one, shot size changing: sharp 0.3-0.8s moves, each ending on the beat's focus. The hamster fills half the frame height, except close-ups.

audio.delivery: weary deadpan; cashier female, hamster male; native

timeline.a: close-up: the terminal in the cashier's right hand thrusts into the lens, red cross flashing, filling the frame; below, the hamster's huge cheeks
timeline.c: drops from high to the cross

timeline.a: the cashier says, her face and mouth visible in frame, pulling back the terminal in her right hand; the loaf in its paper bag lies on the lane by the cashier; the hamster slaps his left cheek
timeline.c: whips across his cheeks to her face

timeline.a: the cashier says, her face and mouth visible in frame, sets the terminal down, lifts the loaf from the lane in her left hand
the hamster says, mouth free, muzzle in frame, plants both paws on the counter, leans in like a depositor
the hamster says, mouth free, muzzle in frame, slaps both cheeks, presenting them like a wallet
close-up: the hamster opens his mouth, coins pour onto the moving lane, bouncing into the lens, filling the frame
his cheeks deflate; he washes his face; the cashier presses stop
the cashier says, her face and mouth visible in frame, her right palm flicking stacks off the coin pile, counting
timeline.c: diving over the palm to her face

timeline.a: close-up: one shove of her right palm, the loaf still in her left hand, shoves the pile at the hamster, into the lens; behind, his thin face with empty cheeks fills the frame, warm light catches his hollow cheeks, background blurred
timeline.c: the camera hurls itself to his face

timeline.a: the hamster says, mouth free, muzzle in the foreground, points at the loaf in the cashier's left hand; she lifts it over the scanner
close-up: the hamster snatches the loaf from her hand, two shoves, cheeks swell, freezes; red cross in the upper foreground exactly as at 0.0, swollen cheeks below it in the same place as at 0.0
timeline.c: jolts back up to the high angle of 0.0

negative_prompt: slow speech, drawn-out delivery, subtitles, watermark, text overlay, logos, English speech, foreign accent, a line said twice, an inserted word, chewing at the end, night, dark scene, static camera, zoom, visible camera equipment, floating objects, duplicate props, extra limbs, extra characters, baguette, grey tones, red or orange uniform
